title: Anger Test
description: Get to know your anger triggers and how you tend to express frustration.

questions.ang_1: Small things easily make me feel very irritated or frustrated.
questions.ang_2: When I'm angry, I tend to bottle it up until it finally explodes.
questions.ang_3: I often say or do things I regret when I'm emotional.
questions.ang_4: My heart pounds and my muscles tense up physically when I'm angry.
questions.ang_5: I feel that other people deliberately try to make me angry or annoy me.
questions.ang_6: I often raise my voice or snap during arguments.
questions.ang_7: It's hard for me to forgive people who hurt me, even long afterwards.
questions.ang_8: When I'm angry, I feel like breaking things or slamming doors.
questions.ang_9: I can stay angry for days over one small incident.
questions.ang_10: I often give people the silent treatment when I'm upset with them.
questions.ang_11: I feel no one listens to my opinion unless I get angry.
questions.ang_12: Sometimes I hit a wall or a table to let out my frustration.
questions.ang_13: When I'm alone, I keep replaying the events that made me angry.
questions.ang_14: People close to me have said I have trouble managing my anger.
questions.ang_15: I often get into heated arguments with strangers (e.g. on the road or on social media).
questions.ang_16: I get very angry when my plans don't go exactly the way I expected.
questions.ang_17: I get angry seeing other people break the rules, even when it doesn't affect me directly.
questions.ang_18: When my anger fades, I often feel very guilty.

results.description: You're very patient and keep your anger well under control.
You sometimes explode or bottle up anger, but it's still within a normal range.
Anger often takes control and affects your life and relationships.
